qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0005: R500/R577 look nearly identical in surface depth and preserved chair/table contours. AbsRel slightly worsens0.0548->0.0557, F1 slightly rises0.361->0.365. Both reduce B0 whiteboard-interior error but still miss its perimeter; value correction does not recover the missing boundary.
qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0598: Sofa/floor depth error is similar, AbsRel0.0407->0.0403. R577 has slightly fewer matched tabletop/front-leg fragments, F1 0.555->0.538. Main tabletop shape is retained, while most sofa and leg boundaries remain missed.
qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_1440: Both R models increase broad wall/chair/counter errors over B0. R577 is slightly worse than R500 in AbsRel0.1259->0.1293 and F1 0.519->0.514. Major chair-post/counter fragments remain, with false chair outlines and missing counter edges unresolved.
qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0226: Both R models greatly reduce B0 broad wall/person scale error. R577 changes little beyond R500: AbsRel0.2537->0.2501, F1 0.512->0.510. Person/column/sofa silhouettes persist, but displaced branch edges and missed furniture remain.
qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0246: R577 slightly improves AbsRel0.1355->0.1321 and F1 0.513->0.524 over R500. The main foreground contours are similar; the false ceiling discontinuity and missed narrow shelf structure persist. Both R models still have greater broad wall/ceiling depth error than B0.
qualitative_incremental_cases.nyuv2_0080: A limited positive increment: AbsRel0.0892->0.0846 and F1 0.237->0.275, with slightly extended matched central/lower shelf-post fragments. Most shelf boundaries remain missed; this is not full thin-structure recovery.

qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0005: Final changes broad wall/board values slightly and worsens AbsRel0.0557->0.0605; F1 remains0.365->0.366. Main table/chair contours stay in place, whiteboard perimeter remains absent.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0598: Same tabletop silhouette and near-identical edge fragments; small final worsening AbsRel0.0403->0.0417, F1 0.538->0.537. Both remain better than B0 in depth values.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_1440: Both endpoints are worse than B0 on broad surfaces, with final AbsRel0.1293->0.1335. F1 stays about0.513; chair-post/counter fragments remain, no major endpoint boundary loss.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0226: Final improves broad depth error further0.2501->0.2360 while F1 stays0.510. Branch displacement and missed background furniture persist. This is a positive endpoint depth example.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0246: Final broad-surface errors increase0.1321->0.1458 even though F1 stays0.524->0.525. Foreground contours remain; stable boundary detection does not ensure accurate wall depth.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0080: Best/final look very similar. AbsRel0.08457->0.08448 and F1 0.2749->0.2722; predicted edges230->224. A few tiny shelf fragments change, most GT boundaries remain missed. No near-total endpoint collapse.

interpretation: The first R577 seed retains stable endpoint behavior and depth/boundary improvement over B0. Additional data beyond500 has uncertain incremental benefit and mixed local changes. Await remaining seeds and L/J/S before data-efficiency or method rankings.
